_comment: Physics inputs of the VIBES bar engine for tools/gen_bars.py. Every row carries src (the report row it comes from: A..F = private/vibraphone/research reports, *-VAL = their validations, REF = private/vibraphone/ref_measure.md, numbers only) and status (CONFIRMED, CORRECTED, DERIVED, MEASURED-REF, ESTIMATE). gen_bars.py --strict fails on an ESTIMATE without a settle entry (the experiment that closes it, PLAN section 14). MIDI keys are the sounding pitch (the reference files are named one octave low; the octave is already corrected here). The reference recordings were measured in place by tools/vib_ref_measure.py; nothing from them but these numbers is used.

keys._doc: every MIDI note 21..108 plays its own pitch (PLAN 13.1); F3..F6 (53..89) is the real instrument, outside the bar physics is extrapolated and flagged

T12._doc: bar outline per key: length and width interpolated geometrically in semitones between F3 and F6, constant thickness; 6061 aluminium. Outside F3..F6 the F3 / F6 bar is used and its frequencies scaled (flag bit0)
T12.src: E:3.1 [YV2700]; F:2.2 (Beaton pp. 66, 73; F-VAL #39); material F-VAL #43 (BS22 thesis Table A.1)

T9a._doc: tuned ratios of V2, V3 (the undercut profile is optimised by bar_fe.py to hit them on the nominal bar); bar_fe tunes 1:4:10 up to v3_tuned_max_key and 1:4 above (on the 13.2 mm YV-2700 outline 1:4:10 needs the centre cut to the 1.5 mm floor from G#4 up: a different, unrealistic profile family). Only the strike-weight shapes come from the FE; the engine's V2/V3 frequencies are these ratios with the T11 detune everywhere

T11._doc: per-key deterministic detune in cents, uniform within the measured spread (a hash of the key)

T10._doc: V4, the untuned upper bending mode: ratio, last key where it is present (low half only)
T10._doc_max_key: the reference shows V4 only up to G4 (67); the model keeps it wherever the bar has it (mode_coefs drops it above 18 kHz): with MED YARN at v100 it falls under the reference's -50 dB detection floor above G4 by itself, and a cut there made a 20-25 % brightness step with RUBBER

T9b._doc: torsion T1, T2: computed per key by bar_fe.py (Saint-Venant on the undercut profile); the expected ranges are checks

T9c._doc: torsion level at TONE +63 (y = 0.45 W), T1 slot peak re V1 slot peak at the onset, MED YARN v100; 0 on the centreline (and off at TONE <= 0)
T9c._doc_2026_10_17: was -24 (the middle of the settle range): the edge strike was not heard (user: STRIKE does nothing); -15 is the range's top, a clearly metallic edge
T9c.settle: O10: listening at TONE +63 (VL) within -15..-35 dB, or drop T1/T2

T9d._doc: torsion decay: the V-mode law (T2 law below) at the torsion frequency, times this
T9d.settle: O5/O10: listening; a measurement if torsional partials are ever found

T15.settle: O12: listening after P7 with and without

cap._doc: material cap on every bar mode: T60 <= 6.908 / (pi f eta)

T1a._doc: V1 free T60 (no tube), pedal down: a (f_ref / f)^exp, clamped; the generator input that, with the tube, must give T1b
T1a.src: D:7 ([SDA23] 15 s at 169 Hz, models 21-31 s; slope D-VAL #67)
T1a.settle: not measurable from the reference set (tubes present); sigma is solved against T1b, so T1a only sets how much the tube shortens V1 (O4)

T1b._doc: V1 T60 WITH the tube, pedal down (the heard decay), per reference note; the generator smooths it (median of +-smooth_keys reference neighbours, the window shrinking at the ends, as bartube.smooth_median) and solves sigma per key to hit it; outside F3..F6 the end value follows (f_end / f)^extrap_exp, clamped; where it exceeds the free bar's T60 (T1a, the top keys) the target is T1a and sigma is its minimum
T1b.src: REF:ref_measure.md (22 notes, motor off, 6 s files); cross-check [WANG12] C4 5.7 s; D:7 law outside

extrap.src: D:7 law 10 (174.6/f)^0.45, anchored at the end notes
extrap.settle: range outside F3..F6 is extrapolated by design (PLAN 13.1); listening

T2._doc: upper-mode decays (held, pedal down) per reference note; black keys log-interpolated; past the table ends T60 follows the law T60_1,free (f1/fn)^q anchored at the end note; then the cap. A mode is silent (b = 0, th kept) above max_key. 2026-10-17 (the cards-audible pass): V2 and V3 are kept on every key (max_key 108; mode_coefs drops a mode over 18 kHz). The reference shows them only up to measured_max_key because there they fall under its -50 dB detection floor with its (yarn) mallet; the bar has them on every key, and a hard mallet brings them out (with b = 0 above G5 / C5 no mallet changed the top octave at all: a pure sine with every mallet). Gate VA keeps the reference: MED YARN v100 V2 / V3 under -50 dB re V1 above the measured keys
T2._doc_taper: V4's amplitude ramps down linearly over the last taper_keys keys up to its max_key (the reference's 'absent' is its -50 dB detection floor, not a cliff; a hard cut made a 25 % centroid step at G4 / G#4 with RUBBER v127; V2 and V3 end where they are already ~-47 dB)
T2.src: REF:ref_measure.md; D:7 with D-VAL #73-#75, #77 for the law and the cap

law.settle: O5: listening (outside F3..F6 and for T1/T2 only)

T3._doc: felt (damper on) T60 of V1: v1_s x the multiplier curve (log-interpolated over MIDI keys, flat outside); upper modes and torsion x upper_mult; never longer than the held T60

T3b._doc: felt onset: the existing 7-sub-block crossfade (40.6 ms)

T3c._doc: half pedal: PEDAL_W interpolation, as the Rhodes

T4a._doc: tube damping zeta_r (percent of critical), solved per reference note from the SMOOTHED measured f0-envelope peak (T5c) with the vib_ref_measure.py procedure applied to the model (bartube.f0_peak_ms), bounded by lo_pct..hi_pct; black keys log-interpolated; outside F3..F6 the E curve's trend scaled to the end note. Coordinator 2026-10-17: the floor is 0.5 % where the measured peaks need it (A4 up), superseding the 0.73 % / E-curve floor
T4a._doc_E_floor: where even lo_pct peaks too early (the peak cannot be met), max(E_floor_pct, the E curve) is used when its peak is still within the Gate VA tolerance (more coupling headroom; the integer map stays contracting at the top)
T4a._doc_trade: T60 first (user rule 2026-10-17: the decay matters more to the ear than 10-20 ms of tube peak): where sigma clamps at the zeta_r that meets the peak, zeta_r moves (down when V1 rings too long, up when too short) until T1b is met, as far as the peak stays within the Gate VA tolerance (+-15 ms or +-30 %) less trade_margin_ms (one STFT hop: the golden render reads up to one hop off the float design); a reading cannot go below 0, so for targets <= 15 ms the band runs down to 0
T4a._doc_resolution: targets <= 15 ms are at the procedure's resolution (93 ms window, 5 ms hop: the build-up is not resolved): there the smallest zeta_r that reads under the target says nothing, and max(E_floor_pct, the E curve) (the radiation-driven damping) is used when it reads within the band (B5..F6; it also keeps the top octave's extrapolation on the E curve's trend instead of a 0.5 % tube)
T4a.src: REF:ref_measure.md via the peak time (T5c); E:3.1, E:3.3 ([SDA23] 0.73 % PVC, M) for the trend outside; coordinator decision 3

T4b._doc: tube detune c_k in cents on the bar-loaded tube frequency (linear in semitones between the points, flat outside)
T4b._doc_2026_10_17: was +5 c (F3) -> +20 c (C6) -> +100 c (F6). The reference set contradicts the sharp top: (1) F6 rings 2.4 s against a 5 s free bar, which with +100 c needs sigma 0.0096 (1.7x E-VAL's top; with +5 c 0.0051); (2) a tube 15-20 c sharp at D5..A5 beats (5-8 Hz) and caps the f0 build-up at ~1/(2 df), so the measured 30-45 ms peaks needed zeta_r under the 0.5 % floor, while within a few cents they are met at 1.0-1.6 % (closer to the radiation estimate); (3) with +100 c the integer pair's coupling (a per-sample phase lag ~ theta) turned anti-damping above D7 (the kc bisection stuck at its bound). A tube tuned to the bar within a few cents agrees with all three. The VINTAGE variant's random +-3 c (T17) sits on top
T4b.src: REF:ref_measure.md (F6 T60, D5..A5 f0 peaks; see _doc_2026_10_17); E:4 row 9 (E-VAL V9: the old curve was an estimate guided by marimba practice)
T4b.settle: O8: listening (sustain vs volume); a beat count on a longer recording

T5a._doc: bar-tube coupling sigma (SDA23, dimensionless), solved per key to hit T1b, bounded, flagged if clamped; weak regime asserted at BELL 127
T5a._doc_lo: lo was 0.0015; 0.0008 (2026-10-17, P6: Gate VA now holds the recordings' band-fit T60 within +-2 % of the smoothed table): at G5, A5 and C6 the free bar (T1a 6.3..7.9 s) is only 5..20 % longer than the measured V1-with-tube T60, so even sigma 0.0015 rang 4..8 % short (clamped, flagged)
T5a._doc_hi: hi was 0.006 (E-VAL V14's 0.004-0.0055 rounded up); 0.007 (2026-10-17, coordinator: 'a bit higher if the weak regime and the stability check allow') lets G3 (0.0065) and D4 (0.0069) reach their measured T60s at the zeta_r that meets their peaks (they missed by +17 % / +30 % at 0.006). The weak regime (s_max sigma <= 0.9 (zeta_r - zeta_n)) and the integer-map grid (rho < 1) are asserted at every key
T5a.src: E:3.4; E-VAL V14; REF:ref_measure.md (G3, D4 T60)

T5b._doc: tube part over the bar's direct f0 at 0.2 s, BELL 64 (envelope ratio, dB); sets wt per key
T5b.src: C:1.4 (D98 Figs 9-10); E V18 (E-VAL: order of magnitude)
T5b.settle: O7: the reference rise dB if measured; listening on BELL

T5c._doc: f0-envelope peak after the onset (ms), the vib_ref_measure.py procedure (4096-point Hann STFT, 5 ms hop); the generator smooths it like T1b (median of +-smooth_keys reference neighbours, the window shrinking at the ends) and the Gate VA compares against the smoothed values (raw +-15 % reported only)

T6a._doc: motor AM rate (Hz): the existing LFO law 0.5 24^(v/127) clamped at v = 120

T6b._doc: opening law o = 1 - |cos phi|, g = g_c + (1 - g_c) o^p, p = 1 + SHAPE/127

T6c._doc: closed-state residual on the tube path
T6c.settle: O9: VA-M depth 7-11 dB and listening

T6d._doc: motor depth target: full-band peak-to-trough late in the note (dB), at depth 127, 3.5 Hz, A4

T6f._doc: FM from the pair: report, sanity bound (cents)

T7a._doc: contact law F = K d^p while compressed, re-contact allowed (tools/hammer.py)

T7b._doc: effective mallet mass (g) at HAMMER 0 / 64 / 127, log between; the contacts are simulated at HAMMER 64
T7b._doc_2026_10_17: was 15 / 30 / 45 g (the contact 0.79x .. 1.14x: WEIGHT was heard as a level change only); 12 g (a light rattan mallet) to 60 g (a heavy bass mallet) gives 0.74x .. 1.26x, light brighter, heavy darker
T7b._doc_level_comp: share of HAMMER's physical V1 level change (impulse ~ M) that is taken back: 0 = none, 1 = level-neutral

T7c._doc: mallet families (BAR_NFAM order). K in N/m^p; tau_ms_1ms: if set, K is solved for that contact time at 1 m/s on a rigid wall with M_eff 30 g; tc_window_ms: the contact-time check over v1..127 (T7d)
T7c._doc_2026_10_17: the cards-audible pass (user, on the FM-1 at KEY VEL 117: 'mallet option, soft, yarn, etc. has no effect on the sound or barely noticeable', 'I never am able to get a soft mallet hit, just hard hits like a bell'): the families were bunched (contact at v104: SOFT 0.86, MED 0.53, CORD 0.41, RUBBER 0.16 ms) and the yarn laws (p 2.5 / 2) shortened with velocity, so at v117 SOFT was 0.78 ms and every yarn mallet rang the 10th partial (the bell) on the low and middle bars; CORD put that partial in its pulse's first null at A4, so YARN and CORD sounded the same. Now SOFT p 2.0, 2.0 ms at v117 (4 ms at v8; on F3 the 10th partial ~50 dB under RUBBER's, the 4th ~10 dB; above C4 a pure fundamental), YARN p 2.0, 1.14 ms at v117 (2.3 ms at v8; the 10th partial ~25 dB under RUBBER at F3, the 4th ~20 dB at A4), CORD K 2.5e8, 0.26 ms at v117 (the geometric middle of the default and RUBBER), RUBBER as before. DEFAULT is the mallet at MALLET 64, frozen: the blend bars.c played there before (the old MED YARN 0.7 ms with the old CORD K 1e8, KN_FAM fraction 131 / 256), so the default sound does not move; it has no detent name on the card. The radiation, torsion and level calibration stay referenced to the old MED YARN law (calib), as the reference recordings were fitted with it

calib._doc: the contact law the generator's references are rendered with (the R1b radiation fit, the T9c torsion level, the V4 trim, the families' level match at v104): the MED YARN of before 2026-10-17, which those fits were made with; not a played family

T7c.settle: O11: p 1.5 is confirmed; the yarn law by listening (SOFT vs RUBBER at v40 / v127) and hil_scan vibes_velocity

T7d._doc: contact-time windows (ms) over v1..127: hard, medium, soft (MED YARN has no window in the reports: 0.3-1.2 ms, its p 2 law between medium and soft)
T7d._doc_hard: 0.24 on a rigid wall (E-VAL V7); the coupled contact on the real (compliant) bar runs to 0.25 ms in the treble at v8, so the check allows 0.26
T7d._doc_2026_10_17: the generic ranges of E:2.2; each family's own check is its tc_window_ms (T7c): CORD 0.24-0.5 (the hard end of medium, between MED YARN and RUBBER), SOFT 0.6-3.0

T7e._doc: half-sine pulse spectrum: -6 dB at f tau = 0.82, -11 dB at 1.05, first null 1.5

T7f._doc: pulse length cap: the played contact (the whole contact shape, played faster) never extends past f0 tau = f_tau_max (a regular p-law pulse nulls the fundamental at f tau ~ 1.5 and left 20-45 dB level holes with SOFT / MED YARN from E6 up); binds only for the yarn families in the top octave and above
T7f.src: E:2.2 (pulse spectrum, first null 1.5); gen_rhodes main-lobe bound (tc f0 < 0.6) as the precedent
T7f.settle: listening: SOFT / MED YARN in the top octave (VL)

T8._doc: mallet speed vs MIDI velocity: V(v) = v_lo (v_hi / v_lo)^((v - 1) / 126) m/s
T8.src: E:2.4 (1 m/s SIM, 2.1 m/s M); E-VAL #24
T8.settle: O11: the velocity trim levels it; listening on the feel

T13a._doc: strike position over TONE raw 0..127: raw 0 -> x = x_dull L (V2 null), raw 64 -> x = x_bal L on the centreline, raw 127 -> x_bal L at y = y_edge W off-axis; x kept at least node_margin L from the V1 node
T13a.src: B ([HA] L/10, L/3, L/2); F:2.4 (Rucz: torsion ~ off-axis offset, zero on the centreline)

R1._doc: radiation weight per bar mode folded into b: (f_m / f_1)^exp (2 = an acceleration-like dipole); the V2 level vs the reference band is the check (Gate VA)
R1.src: C:5.1 (radiation weights folded into b), C:1.2 (D98 line of dipoles)
R1.settle: VA: V2 level after the attack within the reference -17..-47 dB band; listening

R1b._doc: radiation efficiency of V2, V3, V4 (one constant per mode, all keys): the generator sets it to the median offset between the model's level re V1 (TONE 0, MED YARN, v100, 30..530 ms) and the measured T2 level_db at the reference notes; V2 is antisymmetric (a dipole) and radiates far less than its displacement says
R1b._doc_v4_return_2026_10_17: was 4: with V3 now on every key the band boundary at C5 / C#5 showed RUBBER v127 attack centroid falling 34 % in one key (V4 -4 dB a key); 2 dB a key keeps the step under 25 % (the default mallet's V4 there is under -50 dB either way)
R1b._doc_v4: V4 per key (2026-10-17): the measured V4 stays at -36..-48 dB from F3 to G4 (flat within the scatter), while any mallet pulse rolls V4 (13.76 f0) off steeply with pitch (MED YARN v100: -16 dB at F3 to -70 dB at G4; V3, at 10 f0, does fall as measured), so one constant left V4 ~30 dB loud at F3 and ~28 dB quiet at G4. V4's radiation trim is therefore a straight line in key (least squares over v4_fit_keys) that puts MED YARN v100 V4 on the straight-line fit of the measured levels there; held at its F3 value below F3; above G4 it returns to the single constant at v4_return_db_per_key (the rate it rises at), so V4 falls under the reference's -50 dB detection floor within ~2 keys with MED YARN (the reference: absent above G4). Holding the G4 value instead put RUBBER v127 V4 over full scale at D5 (+1.7 dBFS single voice). The ceiling: the trim never makes V4's attack (free ringing 5..50 ms, re V1) at the brightest voicing (RUBBER v127 HAMMER 0, TONE 0 / 64 / 127; +-3-key mean) brighter than v4_ceiling_db over the single-constant model's brightest key in F3..F6. Why: the measured V4 is flat while the measured V3 (0.46 octave lower) falls 3.4 dB / key, which no mallet pulse can give (both sit on the same spectral slope); followed exactly at MED YARN v100, the V4 trim swings 58 dB over the octave and the harder / faster strikes it implies are implausible (RUBBER v127 V4 +34 dB over V1 at the attack at G4, MED v127 crest +11 dB over its neighbours at G4). With the ceiling, MED v100 follows the measurement from F3 to C4 and stays under it from D4 to G4, where the measured values sit at the reference's -50 dB detection floor
R1b.src: REF:ref_measure.md (T2 level_db); C:1.2 (D98: dipole vs monopole)

prune._doc: slots that never sound: an upper slot (V2 V3 V4 T1 T2) of a key is switched off in the data (b = 0, never lit) when its single-strike peak (the slot's x, free ringing between t0_s and t_s, after the contact) stays below db re the V1 slot's at every voicing of the grid (the four mallet families at their detents, v127, HAMMER 0 / 64 / 127, TONE raw 0 / 32 / 64 / 96 / 127, BELL 64): it is inaudible (the relative sleep puts it to sleep at -54 dB anyway), but bars.c's mode budget counts every lit upper slot. Slot X is off everywhere (T15)

T13b._doc: contact noise: LFSR into two biquads (pole pairs 2 kHz R .9 and 4 kHz R .964, zero pairs 5030 Hz R .98 and 8 kHz R .8), decay tau ~ 23 ms; KN_NZ level -60 + 36 v/127 dB re full scale, 0 at NOISE 0

T14._doc: damper knock: the existing rh_thump / rh_felt on key-up with the band's RUBBER softest pulse

T16._doc: room / mic EQ per bar type: identity (0 biquads)

T17._doc: tube detune per type: VIBES uses T4b only

calib._doc: level calibration, as the Rhodes: per-key gain so v100 at the default knobs has an RMS over 50..300 ms of gain_target_dbfs (the Rhodes' -26 dBFS: the types are level-matched); a global cap so one voice at v127 RUBBER peaks at most peak_dbfs + 3 dB on 90 % of the keys; velocity trim towards the median curve
calib._doc_st77: then the Rhodes level per key (2026-10-17, the hiss / SNR rule: VIBES plays at the Rhodes level): each key's gain is set so its v100 loudness (BS.1770 K-weighted, 0..1 s, the S9 measure) equals the Rhodes STAGE 77 golden render's at the same key, the ST77 curve +-lufs_smooth_keys moving-averaged; the A3-E4-A4 chord (RMS 0..1 s) is reported against ST77 (S9: within 1 LU)
calib._doc_offset: user 2026-10-17: VIBES plays 2.5 dB over the Rhodes loudness: a struck bar has a higher crest factor (the same -2.8 dBFS peak gave its RMS 2.6 dB under the Rhodes), and on the jack its SNR was 2.5 dB lower (71.7 vs 74.2 dB); the limiter takes the polyphonic peaks

card_level._doc: level per card value (bars.c BAR_POSG / BAR_TUBEG on the voice's output gain at note-on): a card that is not a volume knob must not move the loudness more than the plan allows (S9: the 0..300 ms level by <= 6 LU over the sweep). TONE (strike position) is a timbre control: the bar's centre is an antinode of V1 (+3.4 dB re 0.35 L) and of V3 (+17 dB: 0.35 L sits near its node), so the K-weighted level rose 6..14 dB on the low keys and TONE 0 clipped at v127; the timbre stays, the level is held (tone_span_db 0). BELL (tube size): more tube is physically more fundamental (+7..10 dB from no tube to BELL 64, +2 more to 127); its curve keeps its shape, scaled to bell_span_db. Loudness: BS.1770 K-weighted over t_s, v100, the default cards, the mean over the band's keys, re the default point (64). Then the per-voice peak ceiling: every key's largest v127 single-strike peak over peak_grid (golden model, no contact noise) <= peak_ceiling_dbfs, else that key is turned down (reported)
card_level._doc_2026_10_17: the cards-audible pass (user: TUBE and STRIKE do nothing): BELL keeps its physical level curve up to 12 dB over the sweep (was scaled to 4: on a real vibraphone the tube IS mostly a level and bloom change), a bare bar is the quieter, thinner one; TONE moves up to 3 dB (the fuller centre strike) instead of 0. The BELL 0 boost the 4 dB scaling needed was the loudest voicing, so the peaks stay under the ceiling
card_level.src: PLAN 9.2 S9 (a card's sweep moves the 0..300 ms level by <= 6 LU unless that is its job); user rules 2026-10-17 (no clipping in RAW at any voicing; TUBE: compensate to the plan's limit or justify)

type_rec._doc: BAR_TYPE record: mode budget (a cap on the upper live slots over all voices; 48 = every slot: bars.c's CPU cost model sets the cap each block from what runs, the table can only lower it), relative-sleep shift (9 = -54 dB re the f0 component: -42 dB failed S12, lane C), torsion level scale (Q15, the per-key calibration is already in b)
type_rec.settle: O3 / O13: P0 cost calibration, the S12 residual, listening on 8 / 12-note chords
